mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a custom outdoor kitchen and a modular one?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom outdoor kitchen is designed and built from scratch to perfectly fit your space, style, and functional requirements, offering unique material and layout options. Modular kitchens, conversely, consist of pre-fabricated units that are assembled on-site, typically offering quicker installation and often a lower initial cost. The decision often comes down to balancing budget and desired customization; a custom approach allows for seamless integration with your existing home and landscape.
